label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived from new java.util.Random().nextGaussian() at L67, converted via Double.toString().substring(2) at L68. This insecure RNG feeds a security-sensitive remember-me cookie value (set at L96) and session attribute (L99), enabling prediction attacks. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink values are rememberMe.getValue() returning rememberMeKey (server-generated from Random, not user-controlled) and rememberMe.getName() returning cookieName ('rememberMe'+testCaseNumber, derived from class name, not user-controlled). Although cookie values can theoretically be user-controlled, the cookie here is freshly created with server-generated content, so no user input reaches the HTML response sink. Case TP driven by Alert 1.
